This is what happens the night GTA 6 comes out.
At midnight, millions of players grab their controllers… starting in New Zealand, then all around the world.
But first, the download. GTA 6 is up to 212 gigabytes. That won't even fit on a 128-gigabyte phone.
On a fast 100-megabit connection, that's almost five hours. On a slow one, almost a full day.
That's why Rockstar let players preload it nine days early.
Then comes the money. GTA 5 made over 800 million dollars in its first day, and one billion in just three days. A world record.
Analysts expect GTA 6 to beat it.
And for the next few nights… a lot of people won't be sleeping.
